feedback: John likes revision 04 but finds the yellow too dark/mustard. He requests experiments with light blues and greens, excluding light yellow to avoid resembling Grow Easy too closely.
controls: All three edit revision 04 independently. Only the outer background changes; photograph, cream title, cream sticker, dark-green supporting words and layout are requested to remain consistent.

variants.name: Powder blue
variants.colour: a light, soft POWDER BLUE, approximately #91B5CF. Clearly blue rather than grey, lilac or turquoise; fresh and calm, not dark navy
variants.prompt:
Perform a narrowly controlled BACKGROUND COLOUR EDIT of this exact supplied book cover. Output ONE complete cover, same portrait dimensions and layout. This is colour exploration, not a redesign.

REPLACE ONLY THE GOLDEN-YELLOW/MUSTARD OUTER FIELD with a light, soft POWDER BLUE, approximately #91B5CF. Clearly blue rather than grey, lilac or turquoise; fresh and calm, not dark navy. Change the entire continuous outer field: top, broad left margin, right border and bottom footer. Aim for a handsome light pastel with enough body that the existing cream title remains visible; use a restrained matte printed-paper finish, no pronounced gradients or lighting effect. There must be NO remaining mustard/yellow border and no new pale yellow.

Keep EVERY other visual element as close to the supplied image as possible. Do not regenerate, recolour, relight or reinterpret the photograph. Preserve John's exact face, expression, hair, beard, shirt, hands, tomatoes and colander, plus all greenhouse foliage. Do not tint the photo blue or green.

Preserve the warm cream oversized serif title, including exact wording, letterforms, huge V and G crossing the photo boundary, position and scale. Preserve the photograph's rectangular shape, offset location, crop, generous right margin and all geometry. Preserve the circular warm cream subtitle sticker in its exact lower-left position, overlapping photo and margin; preserve its subtle paper texture/shadow and dark green text. Preserve the dark green author name at lower right. Do not change text colours to match the background, add outlines, add shadows to type or adjust any layout.

Exact words remain, each appearing once:
The Vegetable Guru
Your at-a-glance growing companion
John Lennon

The sticker's subtitle remains on four centred lines as in the source. No colour labels, swatches, comparison panels or extra text inside the artwork. A single full-cover image: the supplied design with ONLY the mustard outer background replaced by the specified powder blue colour.
